messages:
maria: Hey all — tiny but cross-cutting PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8421. It touches KV cache eviction and platform routing header. Need approvals from runtime, platform, infra, and a quick security check. TL;DR: change default eviction window to 30s and add X-RW-Region header to routed requests.

jess: @maria I can look now. Quick question: are there performance regressions with the smaller eviction window?

maria: good call. We ran a 1h perf run on staging — no regression, slightly better tail in synthetic load. I pushed the perf logs to the PR (see comment).

jess: :eyes: reading. The runtime change looks fine, but please add a unit test for the eviction TTL boundary. tiny patch suggestion: `if (now - last_access >= eviction_ms) evict()` -> `> eviction_ms` test case.

sam: pinging platform — added the header handling, but we should ensure routing fallback still strips the header for internal-only routes. @sam: can you confirm?

sam: saw it. I verified routing rules locally. We need to update the route-mapping config in platform repo (config/router.yaml) to explicitly allow `X-RW-Region`. I can open the follow-up PR during merge window. Approve from platform side once test added.

tanya: infra check: network-level nothing to change. However, the header size increases per-request by ~20 bytes, we should call that out in the release notes and billing estimates. Also, make sure no ELB header limit issues — I'm running quick curl tests against dogfood env.

izzy: security quick scan: looks fine but request: run SAST+Snyk on the branch (CI currently only runs unit + integration). Also add small note in PR describing threat model for the routed header (we shouldn't trust it from external origins).

maria: thanks — I added `SECURITY.md` snippet and triggered `ci:full` (see comment).

deploy-bot: ci/full pipeline started for runtime#8421 — 5 jobs queued.

maria: CI showed a lint failure on one new file (flake8 E203). Will fix now.

jess: once you add the eviction unit test and fix lint, I can approve. :thumbsup:

maria: pushed fixes: eviction unit test + lint fix + SECURITY.md. @jess @sam @tanya @izzy could you re-check?

jess: reviewed, tests look good. Approved from runtime side. :white_check_mark:

sam: platform OK, will do the small router config follow-up. Approved.

tanya: infra ok. Left a note in the PR about release notes.

izzy: ran Snyk+sast — found one low severity dep warning (log4j false positive) — documented in PR, security ack.

maria: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll merge after the remaining CI run finishes and cut the follow-up router config PR. Merge window is open for next hour.

deploy-bot: ci/full pipeline passed for runtime#8421 — merging as ci:passed.

maria: merged. Leaving the follow-up ticket for platform config: PLAT-1298. Thanks y'all :tada:
